ev_A.fact: During the payroll-access inquiry, I compared endpoint logs and badge records asynchronously, then sent a timeline that led the team to the compromised account.

ev_B.fact: On a live ransomware bridge, I called a contractor laptop the entry point from one alert stream; later disk records showed it was a relay, and isolation delayed the real containment.

E1.fact: The executive response call opens at 08:15 and the board expects a containment recommendation before the first customer notice.

E2.fact: The incident recorder can deliver a correlated host-and-badge timeline at 07:45, thirty minutes before the call.

relational_connector.relation: The user makes strong causal calls after independently connecting records, while an unprepared live bridge previously encouraged a premature conclusion.
